summary.text: Jason Prokop is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 27, serving since 2024. His committee assignments are Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Prokop was born January 24, 1982, in Lincoln and graduated from Crete High School in 2000.
He earned a B.S. in political science and communication studies from Nebraska Wesleyan University in 2004.
His biography lists his occupation as nonprofit executive.
It lists him as married to Jennifer since August 30, 2013, with two children.
